<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 224.120, which in positive‑mode ESI most likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈223.113 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 17 % of base, M+2 ≈ 1.6 %) is consistent with a molecule containing about 16 carbon atoms and no halogens.  

A neutral formula that matches the exact mass is C₁₆H₁₅O (16 C = 192.000 Da, 15 H = 15.117 Da, 1 O = 15.995 Da; total = 223.112 Da). Adding a proton gives 224.119 Da, matching the observed m/z within experimental error.  

Thus the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₁₆H₁₅O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
